info.title: jeeves-watcher
info.description: HTTP API of the jeeves-watcher service: the routes in its endpoint catalog (WATCHER_CATALOG). Every route except GET /status requires the API key as a bearer token when api.apiKey is configured.

get.description: Get watcher service health, version, and uptime.
Query watcher running configuration. Optional JSONPath filter.

post.description: Apply a config patch to the running watcher service.

replace.description: Replace the whole config instead of merging

get.description: Get the JSON Schema for the configuration file.

schema.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for the watcher config.

post.description: Test file paths against config inference rules.

paths.description: File paths to test against the watch scope and rules.

post.description: Validate a candidate config. Optionally test file paths against the config.

config.description: Partial config merged over the current one; omit to check it.

testPaths.description: Paths to run through the candidate config.

post.description: Semantic search over indexed documents. Supports Qdrant filters.

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination.

post.description: Filter-only point query without vector search. Returns metadata for points matching a Qdrant filter.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from previous response for pagination.

countOnly.description: If true, return { count } instead of points.

get.description: List available search facets and their values.

post.description: Render a document (file path, or source reference retrieved through its callback) through the template pipeline.
Walk watched filesystem paths with glob intersection. Returns matching file paths.

globs.description: Globs matched against the watched files.

get.description: Get runtime processing failures. Shows the documents (file path or source reference) that failed processing and why.

type.description: Issue code: type_collision (conflicting metadata types), interpolation_error (template rendering failure), extraction_error (reading, rule application or chunking failed), embedding_error (embedding provider failed), upsert_error (vector store write failed), match_failed (designated rule did not match), rule_missing (designated rule not found), no_content (nothing to embed), source_unavailable (source callback failed), unsupported_content_type (callback returned a non-JSON body).

get.description: VCS state for all roots: enabled state, tracked files, last commit, remote status, commit circuit breaker state. Answers 404 `not_found` when version control is disabled (`vcs.enabled: false`).
Query change history by path or glob with optional date range. Answers 404 `not_found` when version control is disabled (`vcs.enabled: false`).

parameters.name: glob

schema.description: Glob inside a VCS-enabled watch root.

parameters.description: Glob inside a VCS-enabled watch root.

parameters.name: since

schema.description: Only commits after this date (any date git log accepts).

parameters.description: Only commits after this date (any date git log accepts).

parameters.name: until

schema.description: Only commits before this date (any date git log accepts).

parameters.description: Only commits before this date (any date git log accepts).

get.description: Retrieve file content at a specific version. The reply is the raw file content; its content-type follows the file extension. Answers 404 `not_found` when version control is disabled (`vcs.enabled: false`).
Show what changed between two versions, or between a version and current. The reply is a unified diff. Answers 404 `not_found` when version control is disabled (`vcs.enabled: false`).

parameters.name: glob

schema.description: Glob inside a VCS-enabled watch root.

parameters.description: Glob inside a VCS-enabled watch root.

parameters.name: commitEnd

schema.description: Version to diff to (default: the working tree).

parameters.description: Version to diff to (default: the working tree).

get.description: Check whether a path is excluded from version tracking and why. Answers 404 `not_found` when version control is disabled (`vcs.enabled: false`).

parameters.name: path

schema.description: Path inside a VCS-enabled watch root.

parameters.description: Path inside a VCS-enabled watch root.

post.description: Set or update metadata on a document by file path or source reference.
Trigger a scoped reindex of watched files (scope path also accepts source references).

Notify changed source documents ({ source, rule }); queued and coalesced (202), or processed synchronously with ?wait=true. Answers 202 with accepted and rejected references, or with `wait=true` 200 with per-document results.

anyOf.description: Issue code: type_collision (conflicting metadata types), interpolation_error (template rendering failure), extraction_error (reading, rule application or chunking failed), embedding_error (embedding provider failed), upsert_error (vector store write failed), match_failed (designated rule did not match), rule_missing (designated rule not found), no_content (nothing to embed), source_unavailable (source callback failed), unsupported_content_type (callback returned a non-JSON body).

post.description: Re-apply inference rules to existing vector points.
Rebuild the enrichment store from vector point payloads (file points only).
Delete source documents by reference or by Qdrant filter (at least one condition; constrained to points carrying source and no file_path).
Delete points from the vector store by filter.

delete.description: Unregister all external inference rules from a source.

post.description: Restore files from a historical commit (forward-only reversion). Answers 404 `not_found` when version control is disabled (`vcs.enabled: false`).

existingOnly.description: Restore only files that exist in the working tree.

post.description: Manage .gitignore entries for version tracking exclusion. Answers 404 `not_found` when version control is disabled (`vcs.enabled: false`).

glob.description: Glob to add to (or remove from) the nearest .gitignore.

remove.description: Remove the glob instead of adding it.
